printf x | grep -q x  # sigpipe-lint: allow same-line reproduction
# sigpipe-lint: allow line-before reproduction
printf x | grep -q x
printf x |
  grep -q x  # sigpipe-lint: allow multi-line reproduction
printf x | grep -q x  # sigpipe-lint: allow
# sigpipe-lint: allow a blank line below breaks the line-before rule

printf x | grep -q x
